data.originalText: In 2024, I rewrote the Northstar upgrade prompts with a product manager and designer. I moved the usage-limit explanation before the plan comparison and replaced vague button labels with specific next steps.
data.rewrittenText: In 2024, I rewrote the Northstar upgrade prompts alongside a product manager and a designer. The original sequence was backwards: it confronted people with plan comparisons before explaining why their work had stopped. I reset the hierarchy, moving the usage-limit explanation ahead of the tiers so users understood the concrete boundary they had reached before being asked to make a choice. From there, I cut the vague button labels and replaced them with direct, specific next steps. Clear interfaces do not depend on persuasion; they depend on structural honesty and words that tell the reader precisely what happens next.
